sources.title: ML Kit | Google for Developers
sources.snippet: ML Kit's processing happens on-device. This makes it fast and unlocks real-time use cases like processing of camera input. It also works while offline and can be used for processing images and text that need to remain on the device.

sources.title: Custom models with ML Kit | Google for Developers
sources.snippet: Benefits of using ML Kit with custom models The benefits for using a custom image classification model with ML Kit are: Easy-to-use high level APIs - No need to deal with low-level model input/output, handle image pre-/post-processing or building a processing pipeline.

sources.title: mlkit_image_labeling_model_maker.ipynb - Colab
sources.snippet: Model Maker library simplifies the process of adapting and converting a TensorFlow neural-network model to particular input data when deploying this model for on-device ML applications. This notebook shows an end-to-end example that utilizes this Model Maker library to create an image labeling model for ML Kit custom Image Labeling and Object Detection and Tracking features.
